document.name: U.S. Lawful Permanent Resident Status / Green Card
document.description: Official identification confirming lawful permanent resident status in the United States.

privileges.access: No Canadian visitor visa or eTA required
conditions: Must be a lawful permanent resident of the United States

requiredDocuments.description: Valid passport from country/territory of nationality (or equivalent acceptable travel document)
requiredDocuments.validity: Must be valid for duration of stay

requiredDocuments.description: Valid Green Card or equivalent valid proof of U.S. permanent-resident status
requiredDocuments.validity: Must be valid at time of travel

sources.title: IRCC eTA eligibility - Government of Canada
sources.note: Official source confirming U.S. permanent residents are exempt from eTA requirement as of April 26, 2022

sources.title: IRCC Help Centre - Visitor visa exemptions
sources.note: Confirms same rule for all methods of travel to Canada

notes: This privilege addition is based on official Canadian government sources accessed on 2026-10-06. The exemption applies to all modes of transportation to Canada.
